_note: Grammar dictionary developer's file for multifariousICU Support for Trados Studio.
Fill this in for your application and import it on the Expand ICU settings page.
arguments: one entry per base argument the application passes grammatical values for.
Each role names the argument the application passes: 'gender' and 'article' are
kinds in the dictionary, 'count' is the plural argument. 'supplies' lists, per
target language, the dependent kinds the application passes for that argument;
only those are inserted into a message that does not have them. 'keys' respells
the kind's keys for this one argument.
keys: respelling for the whole project. 'rename' maps a default key to your spelling;
'languages' replaces a language's key set outright, or adds a language the
default lacks. Every set ends in 'other', which ICU requires.
other: your words for what the 'other' key holds, shown with each form.
Delete this note and the example entries you do not use.
